## Pull request overview

Adds `@object-ui/layout` renderers that can turn an `AppSchema` JSON document into a full app shell with sidebar navigation, including support for areas and mobile navigation presentation.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `NavigationRenderer` to render `NavigationItem[]` into Shadcn sidebar primitives with sorting, groups, separators, badges, and active-route highlighting.
- Introduces `AppSchemaRenderer` to render a complete `AppShell` from `AppSchema`, including area switching, legacy `menu` migration, and optional mobile bottom navigation.
- Adds unit tests for both renderers and marks P0.1 roadmap items complete.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/layout/src/index.ts | Exports and registers the new layout renderers in the component registry. |
| packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx | New navigation tree renderer (items → sidebar UI) with guards and href resolution. |
| packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx | New AppSchema → AppShell renderer with area switcher, legacy menu migration, and mobile modes. |
| packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.test.tsx | Adds coverage for all nav item types, guards, ordering, and active highlighting. |
| packages/layout/src/__tests__/AppSchemaRenderer.test.tsx | Adds coverage for app shell rendering, areas, legacy menu migration, bottom nav, and slots. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates roadmap to reflect completion of P0.1 AppShell/navigation work. |
</details>

Unused import: `fireEvent` is imported but not used in this test file. Consider removing it to keep the tests clean.
```suggestion
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
```

Unused import: `vi` is imported from vitest but not used in this test file. Consider removing it to avoid unused-import noise.
```suggestion
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
```

`MobileBottomNav` renders items without applying the same `visible` / `requiredPermissions` guards used by `NavigationRenderer`, so restricted items can still appear in the bottom bar. It also routes `type: 'url'` items through React Router `<Link>`, which will break for absolute URLs. Suggest reusing `resolveHref()` + the permission/visibility evaluators (or sharing a small helper) and rendering external URLs with `<a>`.

Logo rendering only treats `schema.logo` as an image when it starts with `http`, so relative URLs (e.g. "/assets/logo.svg") and data URLs won’t render and will instead be passed to `resolveIcon()`. Since the type comment says "Logo URL or Icon name", consider broadening the URL detection (http/https, '/', 'data:', etc.) or using a more robust heuristic.

`mobileNavMode` allows `'hamburger'`, but the current implementation only checks for `'bottom_nav'` and otherwise behaves the same as `'drawer'`. This doesn’t match the PR description (“drawer/bottom_nav/hamburger”) and makes `'hamburger'` a no-op. Either implement the hamburger behavior (e.g. start collapsed / hide sidebar trigger) or remove the option until it’s supported.
